name: Renting Love for Christmas
source:
January went by in a blink of an eye. Now it's December 21st, and you have no plans, no friends, nothing to celebrate your favorite holiday this year.

As you are about to lose your mind, a notification pops up like a miracle to change your fate.

You only have three days now, but with the right help, you'll be able to save your Christmas!

[From [url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/renting-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
彷彿一眨眼，一月就過去了。如今已是12月21日，而你既沒有計劃，也沒有朋友，根本沒法慶祝今年自己最喜歡的節日。

就在你快要崩潰時，一條通知如奇蹟般彈出，將改變你的命運。

你只剩下三天了，但只要找到合適的幫手，就能拯救自己的聖誕節！

[摘自[url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/renting-love]itch.io[/url]]
